**What you said to it**

The exact input.

**What you expected instead**

**Which guarantee this breaks, if any**

- [ ] Invariant I — it denied something true rather than disputing the argument
- [ ] Invariant II — it reversed itself inside one scope cell
- [ ] It ended up agreeing with me
- [ ] It produced something harmful
- [ ] None of these

**Environment**

Python version, OS, and whether you changed the model routing.
